items.title: Interactive
items.text: Safer interactive shell defaults for file operations. Adds confirmation prompts when running destructive commands.

items.title: Aliases
items.text:
• cp: Run cp -i in interactive shells.
  • ln: Run ln -i in interactive shells.
  • mv: Run mv -i in interactive shells.
  • rm: Run rm -I in interactive shells.
  • rma: Run rm -rfI in interactive shells.
